When these vendors run sales

Launch weeks are the usual pattern: a new video model is unlimited on credit plans and 30–75% off on APIs for one to four weeks. The holiday window, about Nov 20 through Jan 8, is the long one. In 2025 Higgsfield posted several waves, Magnific used a 50% code, and Krea posted 40% off yearly plans. End dates move. They get extended, reopened, or left as "limited time." If a page does not name an end date, this site does not invent one. Black Friday and holiday deals · Higgsfield Black Friday 2026: what you save per second · Unlimited Seedance 2.5 plans compared.

Spending Google AI plan credits on Veo 3.1 or Omni Flash? The Google Flow credits calculator turns them into videos and dollars per second.
